framework: React Native / Expo with NativeWind (Tailwind for RN)
design_philosophy: High-Density, Fast-Scanning Quick Commerce (Q-commerce). Replacing the slow, premium editorial UI with a high-conversion, speed-optimized UI inspired by Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, and Zepto while retaining Gharana's quality focus.

typography.primary_font: General Sans or Manrope (sans-serif geometric, highly legible)

rules.headings: Tight tracking (tracking-tight), high contrast, bold weights for category and rail titles.
rules.body: Clean, geometric sans for legibility in dense product grids. text-xs and text-sm heavily used.
banned_fonts: Serifs (banned for this specific high-speed app context)

colors.strategy: Archetype 2: Performance Pro (Speed & Action) adapted for Q-Commerce.

brand_primary.usage: CTAs, Add Buttons, Active Tab, Key promotional highlights. Represents 'Gharana's' warm saffron/heritage vibe but electric for speed.

brand_secondary.usage: Success states, 'Veg' indicator dots, ETA text (e.g., 'Delivery in 8 mins').

background.usage: App screen background to allow white cards to pop.

surface.usage: Product cards, Headers, Bottom Tabs, Category Squircles.

rules: NO GRADIENT BACKGROUNDS for primary surfaces. Solid flat colors.
Use #FEE2E2 (red-100) or #FFEDD5 (orange-100) for subtle discount tags.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: Tighter than standard web. p-2, p-3, p-4 are standard for mobile grids to maximize viewport usage.

structure: 1. Sticky Header: White bg, padding-top for safe area. Location selector (left), Profile avatar (right). 'Delivery in 8 mins' prominent text.
2. Search Bar: Pinned under header or scrolls. Gray background (bg-gray-100), rounded-xl, placeholder 'Search "Atta"', search & mic icons.
3. Promo Carousel: Horizontal ScrollView. Wide rectangular banners with rounded-2xl.
4. Bento Category Grid: 3 or 4 columns. Squircles (rounded-2xl) containing product imagery + 1-line text.
5. Product Rails: 'Bestsellers', 'Fresh Picks'. Horizontal ScrollView of vertical product cards.

product_grid.style: 2-column or 3-column vertical grid depending on screen width. gap-3.
product_grid.card_geometry: Vertical rectangle. width approx 140px-160px for rails. rounded-xl. bg-white. shadow-sm or border border-gray-100.

anatomy: Top Image Area: bg-gray-50, rounded-t-xl, aspect-square. Image centered.
Discount Badge: Absolute positioned top-left. text-[10px] bg-orange-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-br-lg.
Delivery Tag: Tiny text '8 MINS' with clock icon.
Bottom Row: Flex row, justify-between, items-end.
Price Block: Stacked or row. Current price bold, old price line-through.
Add Button: border border-orange-500 text-orange-500 text-xs font-bold px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg. When clicked, transitions to [- 1 +] stepper with bg-orange-500 text-white.

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed bottom. bg-white border-t border-gray-100 pb-safe pt-2 flex-row justify-around.
bottom_navigation.active_state: text-orange-500 icon & text. Inactive is text-gray-400.

floating_cart_bar.style: Absolute positioned above bottom tab. bg-orange-500 mx-4 mb-2 p-3 rounded-xl flex-row justify-between items-center shadow-lg.
floating_cart_bar.content: Left: '2 items | ₹245'. Right: 'View Cart >'. text-white font-bold.

search_bar.style: flex-row items-center bg-gray-100 rounded-xl p-3 mx-4 my-2
search_bar.icons: Magnifying glass left, Mic icon right (text-gray-400)

rules: Micro-interactions: Active opacity (active:opacity-70) on touchable elements.
Stepper Animation: Smooth expand from 'ADD' to ' - 1 + '.
Scroll Velocity: Fast, fluid scrolling. Use Native FlatList or ScrollView.
Feedback: Haptic feedback on 'ADD' to cart actions.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use subtle borders (border border-gray-100) instead of heavy shadows for standard cards to improve rendering performance and keep UI clean.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React Native or Phosphor. Weight: Bold or Filled for active, Regular for inactive.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-2xl for banners, rounded-lg for buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Orange text on White has sufficient contrast, or use bold weights. White text on Orange background is standard.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements (buttons, +/-, icons).
accessibility.test_ids: All touchable elements must have testID prop (e.g., testID='add-to-cart-button').

promo_banner_1.description: Assorted fresh vegetables on a rack. Use as background for 'Farm Fresh' promo banner with dark overlay and white text.

promo_banner_2.description: Assorted groceries. Use for 'Daily Essentials' banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the previous premium/editorial layout. Gharana is now a high-density, speed-optimized Q-commerce app.
Implement using React Native / Expo components (View, Text, ScrollView, FlatList, TouchableOpacity).
Use NativeWind styling syntax (className='flex-1 bg-white' etc.).
Structure the code into components: HomeHeader, SearchBar, PromoBanners, CategoryGrid, ProductRail, ProductCard, BottomTabBar.
Ensure the 'ADD' button has a distinct state toggle between [ADD] and [- 1 +].
Implement the sticky 'Floating Cart Bar' that appears when items are in cart, positioned above the bottom navigation.
Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span). This is a React Native app.
Apply `testID` (not data-testid) for RN testing on all interactable elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts; use left-aligned, scan-friendly grids.
Create depth through distinct background vs card colors (bg-gray-100 app background, bg-white cards).
Use pill-shaped or rounded-lg for buttons. Avoid sharp corners.
Never use placeholder image services. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure no text overlaps without proper contrast/overlays.
